title: Jordan News — 'North Korea Reaffirms Its Nuclear State Status Is Final and Irreversible'
snippet: North Korea reaffirms its nuclear state status is 'final and irreversible', stating that the country's nuclear program aims to deter external threats, protect sovereignty and national security, and ensure regional stability. Kim Yo Jong called the policy a 'line of no retreat' earlier this month.
tag_reason: src-001과 동일 외무성 담화의 추가 국제 보도. 김여정 '후퇴 없는 노선(line of no retreat)' 발언 포함으로 유의미한 추가 정보.
